Packages that use FieldLifecycleModel
Package
Description
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.lifecycle
Integrated field- and area-development simulation from reservoir and wells through new or existing shared SURF, greenfield facility sizing or multi-host brownfield allocation, detailed single- or multi-area process models, bottlenecks, modification candidates, product specifications, export, injection, emissions and economics.
